title: Slice and restriction forms along x ↦ ι(t, x): test forms, pointwise bounds, Lipschitz dependence on t, support
statement: Assume (CB), the exact frozen type of Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_lp_covector_bounds: (L1) for all N, N', k ∈ ℕ, every continuous linear A : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} and every k-covector β on ℝ^{N'}, |β.compContinuousLinearMap A| ≤ ‖A‖^k·|β| (where (β.compContinuousLinearMap A)(w) = β(Aw_1, …, Aw_k)); and (L2) for all N, k, every v ∈ ℝ^N and every (k+1)-covector β on ℝ^N, |β.curryLeft v| ≤ ‖v‖·|β| (where (β.curryLeft v)(w) = β(v, w_1, …, w_k)). Write ι(t, x) := (t, x_1, …, x_N) ∈ ℝ^{N+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))), e₀ := (1, 0, …, 0) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1), Jv := ι(0, v), |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α, Dω := fderiv ℝ ω, and 𝒟^k(ℝ^m) := TestFormOn univ k (smooth compactly supported k-forms on ℝ^m). Then: (A) for all N, k ∈ ℕ and every ω ∈ 𝒟^{k+1}(ℝ^{N+1}): (A1) there is a family η : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with η_t(x)(v_1, …, v_k) = ω(ι(t, x))(e₀, Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all t ∈ ℝ, x ∈ ℝ^N, v ∈ (ℝ^N)^k (the slice formula); (A2) there is c ≥ 0 such that every family η satisfying the slice formula has, for all s, t ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^N, (i) |η_t(x)| ≤ |ω(ι(t, x))|, (ii) |η_s(x) − η_t(x)| ≤ c|s − t|, and (iii) tsupport η_t ⊆ {x : ι(t, x) ∈ tsupport ω}. (B) For all N, k ∈ ℕ and every ω ∈ 𝒟^k(ℝ^{N+1}): (B1) there is a family β : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with β_s(x)(v) = ω(ι(s, x))(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all s, x, v; (B2) there is a family γ : ℝ → 𝒟^k(ℝ^N) with γ_t(x)(v) = (Dω(ι(t, x))e₀)(Jv_1, …, Jv_k) for all t, x, v; (B3) every family β satisfying the formula of (B1) has |β_s(x)| ≤ |ω(ι(s, x))| for all s, x.

(η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ c * |s - t|) ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, tsupport (η t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) ⊆ {x : Euclid N | (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) : Euclid (N + 1)) ∈ tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (k + 1))}) ∧ ∀ (N k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid (N + 1))) k), (∃ β : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ (∃ γ : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (γ t : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = fderiv ℝ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) ∧ ∀ β : ℝ → TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k, (∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N) (v : Fin k → Euclid N), (β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x v = (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), covectorEuclideanNorm ((β s : DifferentialForm (Euclid N) k) x) ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) k) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons s (WithLp.ofLp x))))
